text: dsh-pdf-reader 是一款面向 DSH 网页客户端的 PDF 阅读与 AI 分析插件，可在会话中打开多份 PDF，浏览目录、缩略图并搜索和定位页面。它在浏览器侧提供阅读器面板、文本选择、书签和批注，并将有界的页面文本索引同步到会话工具。用户可询问整份文档、组合文字与图像证据、快速翻译选中文本，也可在明确授权后按需 OCR。适合需要在 DSH 对话中阅读和分析技术文档的人；无需额外 API Key，AI 功能使用当前 Harness 模型。

dsh-pdf-reader is a PDF reader for DSH web. It adds multi-document tabs, outlines, search, text selection, bookmarks, and annotations. Ask the active Harness model about PDFs, combine text and image evidence, translate selections, or request authorized OCR for selected pages.
想在 DSH 对话旁边直接打开和阅读 PDF。
我需要从长篇 PDF 的目录和全文搜索里快速找到相关页。
能不能让 AI 回答整份文档的问题并给出页码来源？
我想把 PDF 里的段落选出来让模型解释或翻译。
需要把图表截图和附近文字一起交给模型分析。
扫描版 PDF 找不到文字时，能否只识别我指定的页面？
I want to read and annotate PDFs beside my DSH conversation.
Help me search a long PDF and ask questions about selected pages.
Can I combine a diagram and its surrounding text for an AI question?
I need OCR for selected pages of a scanned document after approving it.
dsh-pdf-reader 的功能「multi-pdf」：PDF 阅读器面板：在 DSH 网页会话中打开并切换多份 PDF，浏览页面、目录与缩略图，并保留会话阅读状态。 触发方式为阅读器中的对应操作或会话工具调用。
dsh-pdf-reader 的功能「search」：PDF 页面搜索：对已建立的页面文本索引查询关键词并返回匹配片段和来源位置，帮助定位文档内容。 触发方式为阅读器中的对应操作或会话工具调用。
dsh-pdf-reader 的功能「annotation」：PDF 标注与保存：对选中文本添加高亮、下划线、删除线或评论，再通过另存或确认覆盖写入 PDF。 触发方式为阅读器中的对应操作或会话工具调用。
dsh-pdf-reader 的功能「ai」：PDF AI 问答：选择 PDF 或页面内容发送到当前会话模型，并可组合多份文档的文字与图像证据进行分析。 触发方式为阅读器中的对应操作或会话工具调用。
dsh-pdf-reader 的功能「ocr」：按需 OCR：用户授权后选择相关页在浏览器本地识别文字，也可将少量原页图像交给视觉模型核对。 触发方式为阅读器中的对应操作或会话工具调用。
dsh-pdf-reader 的 OCR 默认关闭，首次使用需联网下载模型；获授权的页面文本或图像仅在用户发起 AI 功能时进入当前会话模型。

dsh-pdf-reader README · 核心能力：- **阅读与导航**：多 PDF 标签、目录、书签、缩略图、全文搜索、跳转历史、缩放、适配和无损旋转
- **文字与批注**：原生文字选择、复制与 AI 操作，以及高亮、下划线、删除线、备注和批注中心
- **取词与快译**：双击英文单词即可选中并弹出阅读菜单；菜单内的“译”按钮直接用默认模型给出单词/短语译文，结果显示在原地，不写入对话
- **图文 AI**：图片区域提问、图文资料篮、多 PDF 共享资料、联合分析和可点击来源回链
- **整份文档问答**：单份或多份 PDF 联合提问，固定本次文档范围，并按来源区分事实与推断
- **按需 OCR**：默认关闭；用户明确授权后由 AI 选择必要页面，预算可配置且不会自动扫描整本
- **保存与恢复**：按对话恢复已打开文档和阅读状态，支持“另存为”及确认后覆盖原文件
- **长文档资源控制**：页面、Canvas、缩略图和索引采用有界或惰性处理；OCR 页面缓存限制为约 64 MiB 或 512 页

源码分工见 [src/README.md](src/README.md)。

dsh-pdf-reader README · 运行要求：- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-alpha.2`
- Node.js `>=24.9.0`
- pnpm `>=11.28.5`
- 支持 IndexedDB、Web Worker、Canvas 和 Blob URL 的现代 Chromium 浏览器
- “覆盖原文件”需要 File System Access API；图片分析需要当前模型支持视觉输入；OCR 首次使用需要联网下载模型

dsh-pdf-reader README · 安装：推荐从 GitHub Releases 下载构建好的 `.tgz`，然后在 DeepSeek Harness checkout 根目录执行：

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pdf-reader-0.1.0-beta.10.tgz
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config | rg dsh-pdf-reader
pnpm dsh web
```

也可以从源码构建：

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
```

随后在 DeepSeek Harness checkout 根目录安装源码目录：

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pdf-reader
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config | rg dsh-pdf-reader
pnpm dsh web
```

dsh-pdf-reader README · 安装：包声明的 `dsh.bundle` 会自动把插件加入 profile，无需修改 Harness 源码或手工编辑 profile patch。卸载命令：

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pdf-reader
```

dsh-pdf-reader README · 数据与隐私：- PDF、阅读状态、未保存批注、书签和图文资料保存在当前站点的浏览器本地存储中；插件不提供独立遥测
- 只有用户明确调用 AI 功能时，相应文字、批注、图片或经授权读取的页面内容才会进入当前 Harness 会话及其模型服务
- OCR 在浏览器本机运行且默认关闭；普通阅读、旋转、搜索和批注不会自动上传或改写 PDF
- “覆盖原文件”仅在持有原生文件句柄、文件未被外部修改且用户再次确认后执行

PDF 内容、批注文字和图片都按不可信资料处理，不会被插件当作系统指令执行。安全问题请参阅 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

dsh-pdf-reader README · 已知限制：- 图片区域选框不能跨页
- 目录和侧栏搜索只读取 PDF 自带信息，不会自动触发 OCR
- 首次 OCR 需要下载 PaddleOCR 模型；离线且无缓存时会失败

dsh-pdf-reader README · dsh-pdf-reader：[简体中文](README.md) | English

An out-of-tree PDF reader plugin for DeepSeek Harness that brings reading, annotation, and AI analysis into the same web workflow. It supports native text, image regions, mixed image-text evidence, multi-PDF questions, and user-authorized on-demand OCR.

> **Release status: Beta.** This version targets DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-alpha.2`. Test save operations on non-critical copies of your PDFs first.

dsh-pdf-reader README · dsh-pdf-reader：

Read technical documents beside the conversation while pages, annotations, mixed evidence, and AI stay in one workflow.
dsh-pdf-reader README · From reading to AI analysis：All demonstrations below use the open textbook [Dive into Deep Learning](https://d2l.ai/d2l-en.pdf).

dsh-pdf-reader README · Ask about entire PDFs：Select one or more PDFs and ask a question directly. OCR is disabled by default and can inspect a small set of relevant pages only after the user authorizes it.
dsh-pdf-reader README · Select text and use AI：Select text to copy, explain, translate, ask a deeper question, or add it to the conversation context and mixed evidence collection.

dsh-pdf-reader README · Create and save annotations：Highlights, underlines, strikethroughs, and comments are supported. Changes are written to a PDF only when the user chooses **Save As** or confirms **Overwrite Original**.

dsh-pdf-reader README · Combine figures with source text：Add diagrams, captions, and related paragraphs to a shared mixed evidence collection, analyze them together, and follow source links in the response back to the original page.

dsh-pdf-reader README · Demo material and licensing：The textbook content shown in the screenshots comes from *Dive into Deep Learning* by Aston Zhang, Zachary C. Lipton, Mu Li, and Alexander J. Smola ([website](https://d2l.ai/) / [PDF](https://d2l.ai/d2l-en.pdf) / [source and license](https://github.com/d2l-ai/d2l-en/blob/master/LICENSE)) and is licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). This repository does not distribute the textbook PDF. Demo screenshots under `docs/images/readme/` that contain textbook pages are shared with attribution under CC BY-SA 4.0; the plugin source and interface code that does not contain textbook material remain under the MIT License.

dsh-pdf-reader README · Core capabilities：- **Reading and navigation:** multi-PDF tabs, outlines, bookmarks, thumbnails, full-text search, navigation history, zoom, fit modes, and non-destructive rotation
- **Text and annotations:** native text selection, copy and AI actions, highlights, underlines, strikethroughs, comments, and an annotation center
- **Word pick and quick translation:** double-click a word to select it and open the reading menu; the menu's translate button returns a dictionary line from the default model in place, without writing a conversation turn
- **Multimodal AI:** image-region questions, a mixed evidence collection, evidence shared across PDFs, combined analysis, and clickable links back to sources
- **Whole-document questions:** ask across one or more PDFs while fixing the document scope for the request and distinguishing sourced facts from inferences
- **On-demand OCR:** disabled by default; after explicit user authorization, AI selects only the necessary pages within configurable budgets and never scans the whole document automatically
- **Save and restore:** restore open documents and reading state per conversation, save a copy, or overwrite the original
dsh-pdf-reader README · Core capabilities：See [src/README.md](src/README.md) for the source layout.

dsh-pdf-reader README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-alpha.2`
- Node.js `>=24.9.0`
- pnpm `>=11.28.5`
- A modern Chromium browser with IndexedDB, Web Worker, Canvas, and Blob URL support
- **Overwrite Original** requires the File System Access API; image analysis requires vision support from the active model; the first OCR run requires network access to download the model

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pdf-reader-0.1.0-beta.10.tgz
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config | rg dsh-pdf-reader
pnpm dsh web
```

You can also build from source:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
```

Then install the source directory from the root of the DeepSeek Harness checkout:

dsh-pdf-reader README · Installation：```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pdf-reader
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config | rg dsh-pdf-reader
pnpm dsh web
```

The package's `dsh.bundle` declaration adds the plugin to the profile automatically. You do not need to modify Harness source code or edit the profile patch manually. To uninstall:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pdf-reader
```

dsh-pdf-reader README · Data and privacy：- PDFs, reading state, unsaved annotations, bookmarks, and mixed evidence are stored in browser-local storage for the current site; the plugin provides no independent telemetry
- Text, annotations, images, or authorized page content enter the current Harness session and its model service only when the user explicitly invokes an AI feature
- OCR runs locally in the browser and is disabled by default; ordinary reading, rotation, search, and annotation do not automatically upload or rewrite a PDF
- **Overwrite Original** runs only when the plugin holds the native file handle, the file has not changed externally, and the user confirms again

dsh-pdf-reader README · Data and privacy：PDF content, annotation text, and images are treated as untrusted material and are never executed as system instructions. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for security reporting.

dsh-pdf-reader README · Development and verification：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm verify       # TypeScript + Node boundary tests
pnpm build        # production build
pnpm check        # verify + build

`pnpm pack` runs a production build first. On memory-constrained machines, prefer `pnpm verify` and leave the complete build to GitHub Actions or another sufficiently resourced release environment. Regular CI verifies the production bundle on Node 24; the `Harness browser compatibility smoke` workflow runs weekly and can also be triggered manually.

dsh-pdf-reader README · Development and verification：Run `scripts/debug-wide.mjs` for local UI regression testing. To regenerate the README screenshots, download the [D2L PDF](https://d2l.ai/d2l-en.pdf), start a local Harness instance, and run:

```sh
D2L_PDF=/absolute/path/to/d2l-en.pdf node scripts/capture-readme.mjs
```

The script fills in demo questions but does not send model requests.

dsh-pdf-reader README · Known limitations：- An image-region selection cannot span pages
- Outline and sidebar search use only information already embedded in the PDF and never trigger OCR automatically
- The first OCR run must download PaddleOCR models; it fails when offline unless those models are already cached
- The 300 MiB file-entry limit is a defensive ceiling, not a promised large-file performance target
- A vision-capable model is required to analyze image regions
- Quick translation uses the Harness default model; without one configured the popover explains why it cannot translate
- The plugin neither modifies nor requires a customized DeepSeek Harness source tree
